blurb: Guests attend the Bristol Renaissance Faire to enjoy live shows including jousting, sword fights, comedians, and balancing acts with a Renaissance theme. The event features immersive decorations, costumed staff and attendees, a variety of food and merchandise, and activities for children including a kids kingdom. It operates rain or shine and encourages cosplay and family participation.
extraNote: Rain or shine event · Ticketing inquiries handled by ShowClix customer care · July 11 thru Sept. 7, 2026
